author: voidloop
body:
So, As you might have noticed, Livestreamers applications are opened, and Some people have already applied, but Feel free to look at http://avicus.net/forums/68cde289e that post for more information about the appliance.
But, Today, I want to say the Ones that already have been accepted, and Congratulate them!
Here they are:
  • Peachy
  • Jozz
  • telibtubbleton
  • Tampopo/Tanpiku
  • Pelpelajax
  • RileGuy.
There are 6 officially confirmed, but there are more to come!

And here, there is a photo of the Suit you´ll have if you get accepted





Some people like me, have sended it but haven´t received a solid reply yet, in that case be pacient, and understand that the staff members have a Lot of things to do everyday, so don´t expect to get answered just right after you have sended it.

Limit of application:11th of April
All replies have to be sent before the 12th of April.
I wish great luck to all of them applying, and have a great time :^)
